rationale: The board asks what a lower threshold would cost, and the retrieved evidence gives an activation effect (c1) and a cost per activation day (c2), which a decision model could combine into a cost per emergency visit avoided over five heat seasons.
alternatives: Narrative review only (considered: would not answer the cost question)
Local before-after evaluation after changing the threshold (deferred: needs a season of data)
whyNotMoreComplex: A full regional model with hospital costs would need data-sharing agreements.

decision.statement: Build a model-based economic evaluation of lowering the activation threshold by 2 degrees, combining the time-series effect on heat-related visits with regional activation costs over five heat seasons.
decision.question: Is lowering the activation threshold good value?

criteria.text: An activation effect and a cost per activation day are available.
The effect of a lower threshold is too uncertain to model.

gates.requirement: Emergency department and ambulance cost data for heat seasons 2023 to 2026

decision.note: Rests on ledger claims c1 and c2; the cost data gate is unknown.

summary: Economic evaluation proposed; one unknown gate.
